source_refs.note: Topic 5.6 (PDF 148, printed 145). MCQ 4 is answered (d); the answer key gives (a). Recorded.

blocks.text: Visualizing data turns numbers into easy-to-understand charts and graphs. Many tools can create them; some of the easiest are Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, which are widely available and make charts and graphs straightforward.

blocks.prompt: Which tool is commonly used for data visualizations: MS Excel, Python (Matplotlib), Tableau, or all of these (MCQ 4)?

items: Visualization tools: Excel and Google Sheets (easiest), also Python Matplotlib and Tableau.
